limitations.note: The counter fix was correct, but removing `ready_b` from the accumulator guard changed the first accepted beat of a group from adding to the existing `data_out` to replacing it when downstream was not ready.
The scoreboard reset its expected sum unconditionally after every group, validating the new behavior rather than checking that the patch preserved the original `ready_b`-dependent accumulation.

limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected because of its cleanup command, so the agent had to resubmit the test before it could run.
